pages.title: Geometer's Table
pages.text: A slate table with a compass and a straightedge and nothing else: everything Euclid built, built again.$(br2)$(thing)Tier 1$() machine.
$(thing)Made on the Extreme Assembly Table$() (it is also a crafting table). The recipe pages at the end of this entry - and JEI - show the pattern.
Set how many sides the polygon has and how careful the straightedge is. π comes out as n·sin(π/n); the error must be below the recipe's tolerance. More sides and more care are closer, but slower.
$(thing)Machine data$(): a single-block machine (4 item and 1 fluid inputs, 1 and 0 outputs).$(br2)$(thing)Makes$(): Euclidean Marble, Golden Ratio Glass, π Crystal.
